description: Python 3.14.7 official Windows x64 installer. Manual only because the reviewed release source does not establish an enforceable minimum Windows version.
purpose: Offer a pinned Python runtime artifact for explicitly selected Windows x64 projects while preserving any existing interpreter and project constraints.
detection: Before proposing, inspect only the participant-approved project declaration and existing interpreter version. If the existing interpreter satisfies the project declaration, do not select this recipe. The reviewed release source does not establish a minimum Windows version here; confirm vendor support manually, and if OS-version support is unknown report manual/unmet. Never rewrite project constraints or lockfiles.
license_notes: Python software is licensed under the Python Software Foundation License Version 2. Python distributions can include components under other licenses; preserve vendor notices. This recipe does not repackage the artifact.
side_effects: No automated installation is supported by this record.
A participant-selected manual install may change PATH or interpreter selection; do not proceed unless the destination and effects are reviewed and existing project versions remain intact.
verification: Manual/unmet until vendor-supported Windows version is established and confirmed. After a separately approved manual installation, invoke the explicit installed executable to verify its version; do not rely on whichever python command appears first on PATH.
